title: About
subtitle: Sherr1 Young
text:
Hello, I am **Sherr1 Young**, an undergraduate at the *School of Mathematical Sciences, Nankai University*. I grew up in **Quanzhou, Fujian**.

My interests include **extremal graph theory**, **additive combinatorics**, and the **Steklov eigenvalue**. Recent honors include the **National Scholarship** (Dec. 2025), the **Jiang Lifu Scholarship**, and several modeling contest prizes; the full record is listed under Awards.
